svg.text: decision_unit — branch condition, normal and forwarded flags
Column A: conditions from the flags stored
with rs1 in the register file (V3). Column
B: the same from the flags of the ALU
result in EX, for a branch whose operand is
forwarded EX->ID. Both are ready early;
fw_ex_id_rs1 only picks one at the end
(V1), so the forwarding compare is not in
